Definition: (only in plural collective) exit, i.e. (geographical) boundary, or (figuratively) deliverance, (actively) source
BiblicalUsage: 1) outgoing, border, a going out, extremity, end, source, escape; 1a) outgoing, extremity (of border); 1b) source (of life); 1c) escape (from death)
